meta.frames: body x forward, y left, z up; pitch > 0 nose down; roll > 0 left up

variants.J: end-roller springs at the nearest joint of the CAD track phase: rear -0.8763, front 0.8617 m; end shoes as D
variants.H: track phase + half pitch (0.0866 m): end rollers on flat shoes (load at the roller axis); raised end shoes moved half a pitch outwards, same gaps (ASSUMPTION: free-span shape fixed relative to the hinge joint)

meta.x3: kn x3, dashpot x sqrt(3) (same heave zeta)
meta.V4_model: vertical damped 3-DoF, step start/stop (V4 reference convention), DOP853 rtol 1e-9 atol 1e-12 max_step 1 ms

meta.model: node-wise Bekker (SCM-type) statics, rigid machine (superstructure top + 4 rods at e = 0) on the crawler, small angles, b = 2 A / perimeter per connected contact patch (4-neighbour), no elastic K, no bulldozing, no lateral interaction between nodes

shapes.SPH: 24 spheres r 0.05 m of layout D (YAML)
shapes.A: 16 block-bottom boxes per track (10 flat shoes at crawler_contact_parts.csv stations, 6 end shoes at their gaps, tilted with the free span), 88.1 x 489.2 mm
shapes.B: 1 flat block-bottom box per track (x -0.830 ... +0.817, 0.489 m wide) + the 6 end-shoe boxes of A
shapes.C: envelope: 1 flat box per track between the free-span hinge points + 1 inclined ramp box per end through the end-shoe gaps (continuous bottom profile, one patch)

meta.reference_plane: block bottom (pad tips +4 mm); the 4 mm pads are taken as pressed in (ASSUMPTION)

validation_winkler.note: Winkler k = 5e+07 Pa/m, block-bottom width x 2 tracks, flat length 1.6472 m; roll ignored in the closed form

soil_damping_R_example.rule: R = 2 zeta sqrt(K m / A_c) (per-area dashpot of SCM, heave of the machine on the crawler, elastic branch)
